title: Save Your Back!
text:
Save Your Back!. I struggle with lower back pain and it is definitely worse when I spend extended time standing on hard floors like we have in our kitchen which is why I got this set of mats.

This set of mats, while not as thick as I expected, definitely help absorb the pressure when standing in front of the sink or stove while working in the kitchen. This takes some of the pressure off of my lower back and delays it from becoming sore.

We have had no problem washing these mats as they have become soiled with typical household cleaners and they continue to look like new. I was not as fond of this pattern in person as I was in the photos - obviously this is a personal preference, it’s too busy for my tastes. I have used the set in my work shop and it’s been fine.

Depending on what you are searching for, there are thicker anti fatigue mats that will absorb more pressure and work better but these are good quality and a reasonable price.
